text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
*yawn* I just can't shake this exhaustion~ 
I've had so many races lately, after all~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I understand. The place I am 
aiming for lies further down this road.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...No, it is nothing. Please pretend you 
did not hear it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Mejiro Bright still has lingering 
fatigue from her race. It might be 
necessary to reconsider her upcoming race 
schedule.
